serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
She did exactly what I expected…
Bot: How did I do?
You: Very nice!
Shanice: What’s so nice about it, she just copied the original.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: Oh yeah? If it’s that easy you can try yourself. Do you know how hard it is to isolate the singing from the instrumentals? 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: That’s not singing dummy! Singing must come from the heart!
Bot: False. That organ has nothing to do with singing. It’s just a glorified pump.
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
Shanice: Give me the microphone! I will show you what I mean!
You: You can sing? 
Shanice: Of course I can! Every nun can sing!
You: I don’t think that’s true…
Shanice: This song will do.
Shanice: Now you will witness what karaoke is all about!
